positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Laid off as part of a RIF that affected 70% of the company.

- Currently leading the design and implementation of an automatic fee calculation and payout system to reduce the time required for fee collection and minimize uncollected fees due to customer withdrawals.
- Successfully launched a self-signup feature within my 1st month, contributing to over 95% of company revenue. Subsequently, managed various complex and high-priority projects, including affiliate tracking, rates payouts, and automated statement generation.
- Stepped in to oversee multiple high-priority projects, overcoming delays, aligning stakeholders and ensuring their timely completion.
- Implemented robust end-to-end testing procedures on our flagship product and systematically addressed and resolved 50+ bugs over 2 months. This led to a smooth certification for our 1st client.
- Pioneered the creation of a new BFF service (Backend for Frontend) with a focus on consistent error handling, authentication protocols and contract driven development
- Spearheaded the intern program, guiding 2 sophomore CS students with no prior professional software engineering experience into productive software engineers in just 10 weeks.
- Acted as an interim Manager for 7 employers over 8 months, and handled everything from promotions to performance issues. Maintained high morale during company-wide salary cuts, highlighting resilience and effective team management. Implemented a 360-degree feedback system across the engineering org, fostering increased growth and collaboration.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and created a new Java gRPC microservice to upload branding assets to Google Cloud Storage
- Led multiple engineering projects from ideation to launch and support. I determined the technical feasibility of the project, evaluate UI mockups, communicate expectations to PMs, designers and our backend team, and mentor and unblock junior engineers on the project
- Implemented new features in React for viewing transactions, issuing refunds and uploading documents used by thousands of Chase merchants
- Lead 3 different teams to increase code quality by migrating code to TypeScript 
- Mentored a Software Engineer Apprentice who converted to a full time Software Engineer
- Conducted over 100+ technical interviews, train and mentor other engineers to lead interviews

positions.title: Software Engineer Apprentice
positions.description: Learned Fullstack Web Development and created different web applications using React, Redux, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Python, Flask and SQLAlchemy

positions.title: High School Mathematics Teacher
positions.description:
- Designed curricula for a wide variety of courses to deliver engaging instruction to a diverse group of students with varying mathematical, linguistic and behavioral needs
- Analyze class data (diagnostic, formative and summative) consistently by their mastery of individual Common Core State Standards in order to tailor future instruction to meet individual students’ needs
- Communicate consistently with parents, guardians and other stakeholders on their student’s progress at school
- Math students made an average of 1.8 years of growth in mathematics as measured by the NWEA MAP test

Courses Taught: 
- Business Management (2017 - 2018)
- Math Intervention ( 2016 - 2018)
- Advisory (2015 - 2018)
- 9th Grade Algebra 1 (2015 - 2017)
- 11th Grade Geometry (2015 - 2016).

positions.title: Corps Member Forum
positions.description:
- Recruit and manage a rotating group of individuals to outreach to individuals who have an offer for Teach For America 
- Increased the matriculation rates of accepted teachers to confirmed teachers to 90%
- Provided direct feedback on high level decisions made by Teach for America Oakland that affect teachers and students

positions.title: Co-President
positions.description:
My role at Out 4 Business at Berkeley (O4B) allowed me to collaborate with different companies on workshops and events that serve the next generation of LGBT professionals. 

I took the initiative to coordinate and plan an event for O4B at the Facebook headquarters to provide our members an inside look of what it is like to work for one of the top tech companies. By working with a liaison from Facebook, I was able to recruit Facebook employees to participate in a Q/A panel, to give a tour, and to network with our members at a lunch. I also coordinated the logistics and finances to bring 13 O4B members to the campus in a timely manner. After the event, I sent out a feedback form to obtain data from those who attended to determine how our attendees enjoyed the event and what we could do better. 

In addition, I was in charge of managing a group of interns who are interested in becoming executive members on our board. My job was to give them a hollistic view of our organization as well as develop and support them professionally so they are fully prepared to take on a leadership position. Finally, I was in charge of securing funding from alumni and potential donors to ensure financial stability in the future.

positions.title: Teaching Fellow
positions.description: As a Teaching Fellow at Breakthrough Oakland my primary responsibility was to endow my students with the mathematical knowledge consistent with the new Common Core standards that would allow them to enter the upcoming academic year with a strong background in math. For my math classes, I collected data daily to track student understanding and change my lesson plans to fit their needs. In addition to teaching math, I co-taught two speech electives, Public Speaking and Debate to increase the confidence and speaking abilities of my students. My role as a Teaching Fellow also included being an active member within my department's daily meetings, as well as leading a committee dedicated to planning and facilitating events that combine academics, physical activity, and community building.

positions.title: Transfer Liaison
positions.description: My work as a Transfer Liaison lead me to help found a new branch of our organization at Laney College in Oakland. There I was able to collaborate with UC Berkeley and Community College students and faculty to provide increased resource to transfer students in the form of one-on-one advising, workshops, and events.
